2. What natally is ↑ Back to Top

natally is a natal-astrology companion. Every astrological value it shows — positions, house cusps, aspect angles, dates — is computed by an astronomical ephemeris engine (Swiss Ephemeris, vendored under its license terms); nothing is invented. Content is labelled by origin: computed facts from the engine, authored educational material (glossary entries), generated companion transcripts (natally's conversational replies, which draw only on your chart and your conversation memory), and honest absence states where a value genuinely cannot be computed (for example, house cusps when a birth time is unknown). natally is for education and entertainment. It is not medical, psychological, legal, or financial advice, and it makes no predictive guarantees.

4. $ROCHE credits ↑ Back to Top

$ROCHE is a consumable chat credit. Credits are integer units held on your payment-platform account; they have no cash value, cannot be cashed out, and expire only as stated at purchase. Each billed request reserves the quoted maximum before running and settles once on completion; failed requests are refunded. Where a platform's rules restrict credits to the app they were bought in, those rules apply and restricted credits never silently mix with others. A depleted balance never revokes an unlimited purchase, unlimited never makes billed features free, we never switch you to paid features without disclosure, and a lifetime purchase is never relabelled a subscription. Refunds follow the processor's policy you paid through.

Redemption codes (NATALLY- format) are single-use. Re-use fails with the true reason shown. Codes are not transferable for value.
